summary: Backend testing for the new self-serve OTP-based Forgot Password flow. Wrote 16 pytest cases covering /api/auth/forgot-password (issuance, non-enumeration, prior-OTP invalidation, rate limiting, invalid email), /api/auth/reset-password OTP flow (wrong OTP, invalid format, no active OTP, expiry, 5-attempt lockout, weak password, happy-path + login + replay-block, missing fields), and legacy token backward compatibility (valid, reuse, invalid, expired). ALL 16 tests PASS. Confirmed: OTP is SHA-256 hashed (no plain OTP in DB), attempts field increments on wrong tries, OTP marked used+invalidated on 5 failed attempts or successful reset, prior unused OTPs are invalidated on new request, response for non-existent email does not leak (no dev_otp, no DB record created), rate-limit fires at 4th request within 10 min, EmailStr validator rejects invalid formats (422), dev_otp only surfaces when email delivery fails (undeliverable admin@glowup.com), reset -> login with new pw works and old pw fails, legacy {token, new_password} flow still works and rejects reuse/invalid/expired. Admin password restored to admin123 after tests via teardown fixture. No backend issues found.
critical_code_review_comments: auth.py:294 — OTP format regex allows 4-8 digits (\d{4,8}) but forgot_password always generates 6 digits. This is fine but slightly loose; not a bug.

auth.py:316-319 — bare `except Exception: pass` on expires_at parsing means malformed expires_at silently skips expiry check (would allow reset with corrupt data). Low risk since we control DB writes, but consider raising a 500 instead.
mailer.py:65 — httpx post uses default timeout=30s; ok, but no retries. A single blip in Emergent proxy will trigger dev_otp fallback for real users too. Acceptable for MVP.
auth.py:243 — invalidating prior OTPs uses update_many which is correct and idempotent. Good.
auth.py:322 — hmac.compare_digest used for constant-time OTP hash comparison. Good.
seed_data_creation: None — tests use existing admin@glowup.com user. Cleanup fixture deletes test password_resets and restores admin password to admin123.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Forgot/reset password OTP flow fully validated. Test file: /app/backend/tests/test_iter19_forgot_password.py. When testing, be aware: (1) admin@glowup.com is 'undeliverable' on Emergent Resend so responses always include dev_otp — real emails would return email_sent=true and no dev_otp; (2) rate-limit is 3 requests per email per 10 min; tests clean password_resets between rate-limit tests; (3) The module-scope autouse fixture restores admin password to admin123 on teardown, so downstream test suites remain green. Backend endpoints stable — no code changes required.
